HEADLINE: Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III and Regulation 33 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, as amended from time to time, please note that the Board of ....
MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III and Regulation 33 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, as amended from time to time, please note that the Board of Directors of the company in its meeting held today has considered and approved the following:
1.The Unaudited Financial Results for the Half-year ended 30.09.2026, along with the Limited Review Report issued by the Statutory Auditors 
2.Appointment of M/s. G R Shah & Associates, PCS, as the Secretarial Auditor of the Company to conduct the Secretarial Audit for the FY 2026-27 ;
3.Appointment of Shah & Jhalawadia, Chartered Accountants (FRN: 0140590W) as the Internal Auditor of the Company for the FY 2026-27 . 
4.The Board took note of the NFRA Circular dated 07.01.2026, regarding effective communication between the Statutory Auditors and TCWG, and the communication made to the Statutory Auditors, M/s. SVJK & Associates.
